set.body: Phase 1 review finding 1 of 8. R/memory.R currently scales source_private_bytes by workers but counts source_block_bytes, relation_block_bytes, atom_block_bytes, contraction temporaries, replacement copies, serialization overlap, reorder buffers, and checkpoint buffers only once. A four-worker plan with three 100-byte task buffers can therefore report 300 modeled bytes instead of at least 1200. Rework the model around n_active * M_task plus shared and durable categories; validate every byte count and worker product as a finite nonnegative whole scalar without overflow. Done when adversarial one-worker and multiworker tests prove conservative accounting for every task-private category and measured-peak checks remain distinct.
set.title: Count every active task buffer in the memory model
